Introduction

Wuuslime, formelly known as Chillin Homie, is a South Korean rapper under Mine Field, who debuted under Dynasty Muzik on September 2, 2018. After leaving he joined VIXX's RAVI's label GROOVL1N, but left on March 26, 2021.
